title: Beyond Beef Lettuce Wraps
description: A light and flavourful dish featuring plant-based ground beef wrapped in crisp lettuce leaves. Quick to prepare and suitable for a casual meal or appetizer.

items.name: beyond burger patties
items.notes: crumbled or use Beyond Beef ground

steps.instruction:
Crumble the Beyond Burger patties or use Beyond Beef ground.
Cook in a skillet over medium heat until browned.
Season to taste.
Spoon the cooked mixture into lettuce leaves and serve.
